note: The scout agent's new strategies (agents/scout_strategies.py). bots: which bots' agents test it (bot1-bot4 portfolios, bot5/bot6 scalping 1-15 minutes, bot7 economic releases); timeframes: what the source states; markets: fx, index, metal, energy, crypto, stock (empty = all of the bot's).

strategies.name: RV EMA20 cross over the 5m EMA200, 0.5% stop, 1:2, 1-minute
strategies.rules: 1m chart: long when price crosses above EMA20 and close > EMA200 of 5m closes (short mirror) / stop 0.5% from entry / target 2x stop (1%)

strategies.name: Alligator + Fractals breakout, fractal stop, 1:3
strategies.rules: M30/H1/H4: Alligator 13/8/5 (shift 8/5/3) awake up, price above it, close above last up-fractal that does not touch the Alligator (short mirror) / stop at last down-fractal / target 1:3

strategies.name: Pavan CPR: cross above top CPR, stop at pivot, long only
strategies.rules: 1m intraday: previous close below TC=(prevH+prevL)/2 and close above it, long only / stop at pivot (H+L+C)/3 / target 50 points (ours: 0.2% of price)

strategies.name: NFP straddle of the 4-hour pre-release range, target = range
strategies.rules: 5m: 30 min before NFP take 4h high/low, buy stop 5-10 pips above high, sell stop 5-10 pips below low (ours: 1 ATR) / stop = the opposite order / target = entry +/- the range

strategies.name: NFP V-shaped reversal candle after the release, 1:3
strategies.rules: 5m/15m: skip the release spike, enter on a reversal candle (hammer) against the first move / tight stop beyond the recent low (high) / target 1:3

strategies.name: Stochastic Hash 16/7/3 cross at 25/70, 3.18R
strategies.rules: 4H+: slow stoch 16/7/3, long when K crosses up D below 25, short when K crosses down D above 70 / stop 2.2% (ours: 1.2 ATR) / target 7% (3.18R), exit at the opposite extreme
